response.sql:
WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS value
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.value;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are the distinct observstation values represented in telescopes; observatories with no telescope rows are excluded because the request specifies observatory in the telescopes table.
